MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. JUdge: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: P. Dias, Reporter: Patricia Dowling. John Gregory Hanlin, Esq. represented the petitioner. Petitioner Judyth Noemi Luarte was sworn and examined. The court grants decree changing petitioner's name to Judith Naomi Aucar. Decree signed in open court.
